item.title: Notify NYC - Unplanned Road Closure - Long Island Expressway (QN)
item.description:
Notification issued 11-02-2026 at 11:53 PM.
Due to a vehicle collision, all westbound lanes of the Long Island Expressway are closed at Kissena Boulevard in Queens. Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time.
